analytic_proof.roster: From a^2-1<alpha_P<=a^2, a=N+theta, and 0<=theta<=1: n_N+1>2(a^2-1) and m_N+1<=a^2/(a-1/2)+2. For a>=4, a^3-3a^2-a+1>0, so their ratio exceeds a.
analytic_proof.odd_integral: Writing the odd integers as 2k+1 and comparing the decreasing summand with its unit-interval integral gives D_N>=(1/2)log((n_N+1)/(m_N+1)).
analytic_proof.logs: Since a^2>exp(L), log(a)>L/2. Also N>=a-1>a/e and N<=a, so log N>L/2-1 and log(a^2/N)>=log(a)>L/2.
analytic_proof.rational_floor: Using pi<22/7 at L=50 gives A_H>328125/22>14900 and A_T>157500/11>14300; both polynomial lower bounds increase for L>=50.

rows.claim: Five parent certificates are hash-pinned and replay-compatible.
D_N is exactly the odd reciprocal sum over m_N<=r<=n_N.
The lower near half-cell has integral 1/2+iD_N/pi.
The upper near half-cell has integral 1/2-iD_N/pi.
The near sum equals the starred carrier plus iD_N(f(1)-f(N))/pi plus one zero-at-cell-centres variation.
After the paired remote correction, the complete join is 2M_N+iD_N(f(1)-f(N))/pi-V_N.
On the fixed physical q=2tL^2=1 chart, D_N>(1/2)log(a)>L/4.
log N>L/2-1 and log(a^2/N)>L/2 on L>=50.
The ideal Hermitian lower endpoint is positive imaginary and its terminal endpoint vanishes.
The raw Hermitian join is -A_H+R_H with A_H=D_N log(N)log(a^2/N)^2/(4pi)>0 and R_H=2M_H-V_H.
Both ideal transpose endpoint values and the conditional terminal survivor remain explicit.
The raw transpose join is -A_T+R_T+Q_T with an explicit h-suppressed complex Q_T.
A stationary cancellation estimate for R_H and R_T+Q_T would turn the raw anchors into phase-independent modulus gaps.
The terminal multiplier rotates either negative raw anchor by the terminal phase, so no physical-current sign follows without a phase sector or the complete Hermitian/transpose projection.
D_N jumps at odd roster transfers; only the complete mode-transfer invariant package may be used across adjacent cutoffs.
The signed stationary residual and every RH-level conclusion remain open.

proof_boundary: This gate proves exact endpoint-anchor decompositions and quantitative raw anchor lower bounds on the fixed q=1 chart. It proves no extension of those floors to other parabolic frequencies, stationary carrier-variation bound, complete physical-current sign, contact-box exclusion, ordinary retained-main separation, Q209 shell, cofinal successor, Lambda<=0, RH, or prize-level conclusion.
